---
title: "Cauchy-Euler Flowchart"
format: html
---

<style>
html, body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden; /* hides white scrollbars */
}

.flow-container-redesign {
  position: relative;
  height: 600px;
  width: 100%;
  background-color: #fefefe;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  align-items: center;
  justify-items: center;
  font-family: sans-serif;
  gap: 40px;
  padding: 20px;
}

.node-redesign {
  padding: 12px 18px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 15px;
  min-width: 200px;
  max-width: 250px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  transition: transform 0.2s;
  position: relative;
}

.node-redesign:hover {
  transform: translateY(-5px);
}

.start-redesign {
  background: #e3f2fd;
  border: 2px solid #1976d2;
  grid-column: 3 / 4;
  grid-row: 1 / 2;
}

.decision-redesign {
  background: #fff8e1;
  border: 2px solid #ff9800;
  grid-column: 3 / 4;
  grid-row: 2 / 3;
  padding: 20px 30px;
}

.result-left {
  background: #e3f2fd;
  border: 2px solid #1976d2;
  grid-column: 2 / 3;
  grid-row: 3 / 4;
}

.result-center {
  background: #fff3e0;
  border: 2px solid #ff9800;
  grid-column: 3 / 4;
  grid-row: 3 / 4;
}

.result-right {
  background: #e3f2fd;
  border: 2px solid #1976d2;
  grid-column: 4 / 5;
  grid-row: 3 / 4;
}
</style>

<div class="flow-container-redesign">
<div id="start-redesign" class="node-redesign start-redesign">
$ax^2 y'' + bxy' + cy = 0$
<br><br>
Auxiliary Equation:<br>
$am^2 + (b-a)m + c = 0$
</div>

  <div id="check-redesign" class="node-redesign decision-redesign">
    Types of Roots (Discriminant)
  </div>

  <div id="real-distinct" class="node-redesign result-left">
    Distinct Real Roots ($m_1 \neq m_2$) <br><br>
    $y = c_1 x^{m_1} + c_2 x^{m_2}$
  </div>

  <div id="real-equal" class="node-redesign result-center">
    Repeated Roots ($m_1 = m_2$) <br><br>
    $y = c_1 x^m + c_2 x^m \ln(x)$
  </div>

  <div id="complex" class="node-redesign result-right">
    Complex Roots ($m = \alpha \pm i\beta$) <br><br>
    $y = x^{\alpha}(c_1 \cos(\beta \ln x) + c_2 \sin(\beta \ln x))$
  </div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leader-line/1.0.7/leader-line.min.js"></script>
<script>
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('start-redesign'),
      document.getElementById('check-redesign'),
      { startPlug: 'disc', endPlug: 'arrow1', size: 2, color: 'grey', path: 'straight', startSocket: 'bottom', endSocket: 'top' }
    );

    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('check-redesign'),
      document.getElementById('real-distinct'),
      { startPlug: 'disc', endPlug: 'arrow1', size: 2, color: 'grey', path: 'arc', startSocket: 'bottom-left', endSocket: 'top' }
    );

    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('check-redesign'),
      document.getElementById('real-equal'),
      { startPlug: 'disc', endPlug: 'arrow1', size: 2, color: 'grey', path: 'straight', startSocket: 'bottom', endSocket: 'top' }
    );

    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('check-redesign'),
      document.getElementById('complex'),
      { startPlug: 'disc', endPlug: 'arrow1', size: 2, color: 'grey', path: 'arc', startSocket: 'bottom-right', endSocket: 'top' }
    );
  });
</script>

<script>
  MathJax = {
    tex: {
      inlineMath: [['$', '$'], ['\\(', '\\)']],
      displayMath: [['$$', '$$'], ['\\[', '\\]']]
    }
  };
</script>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3/es5/tex-mml-chtml.js"></script>
